karty.priklad: Pwy sy'n cario'r fasged?
karty.priklad_cs: Who's carrying the basket? (basged → [f]asged after 'r, feminine)
karty.mnemo: From English basket: a basket piled high with shiny red apples.

extra.pozn: own example, emphatic sentence with sy (grammar of L13)

karty.priklad: Mae alergedd i gnau gyda fi.
karty.priklad_cs: I've got a nut allergy (cnau → [g]nau after i).
karty.mnemo: cnau = nuts (collective), -en = one single nut: a chestnut roasting on an open fire.

extra.pozn: collective plural: cnau = nuts (the more common form), cneuen = one nut; cnau mwnci = peanuts (outside the coursebook); alergedd = allergy (L9); own example

sever.priklad: Mae gen i alergedd i gnau.
sever.priklad_cs: I've got a nut allergy (cnau → [g]nau after i).
sever.pozn: north: Mae gen i instead of Mae … gyda fi (L6)

karty.priklad: Mae chwech o gnau coco yn y llun.
karty.priklad_cs: There are six coconuts in the picture (cnau → [g]nau after o).
karty.mnemo: cneuen (nut) + coco: a coconut cracked open on a red-hot beach.

extra.pozn: in the singular coco → goco after the feminine cneuen, in the plural no mutation (cnau coco); sentence from p. 166 (ffair flynyddol)

karty.priklad: Mae lefel y dŵr yn codi.
karty.priklad_cs: The water level is rising.
karty.mnemo: From English level: the level of red lava creeping up the volcano.

extra.pozn: in the book: tasg ar lefel B1 = a task at B1 level (p. 167); own example

karty.priklad: Mae tafodiaith y De yn wahanol i dafodiaith y Gogledd.
karty.priklad_cs: The southern dialect is different from the northern dialect (gwahanol → [w]ahanol after yn; tafodiaith → [d]afodiaith after i).
karty.mnemo: tafod (tongue) + iaith (language, feminine): every region's tongue is scorched red by its own local hot sauce.

extra.pozn: the word also appears in Robin Radio (p. 170); own example

karty.priklad: Mae Texas yn dalaith fawr iawn yn yr Unol Daleithiau.
karty.priklad_cs: Texas is a very big state in the USA (talaith → [d]alaith after yn; mawr → [f]awr after the feminine talaith; taleithiau → [d]aleithiau in Unol Daleithiau).
karty.mnemo: Each state has a TALL LIGHThouse (TAL-AITH), its lamp glowing red-hot all night.

extra.pozn: yr Unol Daleithiau = the United States (L5), literally "united states"; own example

karty.priklad: Aeth y lleidr i'r carchar am ddwy flynedd.
karty.priklad_cs: The thief went to prison for two years (dwy → [dd]wy after am; blwyddyn → [f]lynedd after dwy).
karty.mnemo: Latin carcer, as in inCARCERate: an ice-cold blue cell.

extra.pozn: carcharu = to imprison (L12); carcharor = prisoner (outside the coursebook); plural = carchar + tai (houses); own example

karty.priklad: Roedd miloedd o gefnogwyr yn y stadiwm.
karty.priklad_cs: There were thousands of supporters in the stadium (cefnogwyr → [g]efnogwyr after o).
karty.mnemo: cefn (back) + -ogwr: the one who's got your back – fans in blue shirts, their scarves stiff with frost.

extra.rod_pozn: grammatically masculine even for a woman
extra.pozn: cefnogi = to support; cefnogaeth = support (L6); own example

karty.priklad: Dyma'r cynllun: Siân sy'n prynu'r bwyd a fi sy'n coginio.
karty.priklad_cs: Here's the plan: Siân is buying the food and I'm cooking (emphatic sentences with sy).
karty.mnemo: cyn (before) + llun (picture): a picture drawn in advance – a plan on blue paper, a blueprint.

extra.pozn: cynllunio = to plan (L6); own example based on the exercise Trefnu parti (pp. 162–163)

karty.cs_upresneni: caretaker of a building or someone who looks after a sick person
karty.priklad: Y gofalwr sy'n agor yr ysgol bob bore.
karty.priklad_cs: The caretaker opens the school every morning (emphatic sentence with sy).
karty.mnemo: gofal (care) + -wr (person): the one who takes care – gritting the icy school steps in blue overalls.

extra.rod_pozn: grammatically masculine even for a woman
extra.pozn: gofal = care (L7); gofalu am = to look after; own example

karty.priklad: Mae'r lleoliad yn berffaith ar gyfer priodas.
karty.priklad_cs: The venue is perfect for a wedding (perffaith → [b]erffaith after yn).
karty.mnemo: lle (place) + lleol (local) → lleoliad: a blue pin stuck into a map of Antarctica.

extra.pozn: own example (topic Trefnu digwyddiad)

karty.priklad: Mae'r paith ym Mhatagonia yn enfawr.
karty.priklad_cs: The pampas in Patagonia is huge (Patagonia → [Mh]atagonia after ym, nasal mutation).
karty.mnemo: A PATH (PAITH) across the frozen steppe.

extra.pozn: linked with the Welsh settlement in Patagonia (video Pobl Patagonia, p. 164); own example

karty.priklad: Mae'r dosbarth yn trefnu parti syrpréis i'r tiwtor.
karty.priklad_cs: The class is organising a surprise party for the tutor.
karty.mnemo: From English surprise: a surprise popping out of a snow globe.

extra.pozn: close in meaning but unrelated native words: synnu = to surprise (L3), syndod = surprise, amazement (L15); sentence based on the task on p. 168

karty.priklad: Fi sy'n gwneud y trefniadau ar gyfer y daith.
karty.priklad_cs: I'm making the arrangements for the trip (taith → [d]aith after y, feminine; emphatic sentence with sy).
karty.mnemo: trefn (order) + -iad: what you put in order in advance – lined up like ice cubes in a tray.

extra.pozn: in the book: e-mail yn dweud beth yw'r trefniadau (p. 168); according to the Geirfa of L2 the plural trefniadau also belongs to trefn (trefn(iadau)); own example

karty.priklad: Hywel a Fflur sy'n addurno'r neuadd.
karty.priklad_cs: Hywel and Fflur are decorating the hall (emphatic sentence with sy).
karty.mnemo: addurn (decoration) → addurno.

extra.pozn: addurn = decoration (L9); sentence from the exercise Trefnu parti, p. 163

karty.priklad: Y cynghorydd sy'n cadeirio'r cyfarfod.
karty.priklad_cs: The councillor is chairing the meeting (emphatic sentence with sy).
karty.mnemo: cadair (chair) → to sit in the chair at the head of the table.

extra.pozn: cadeirydd = chairperson (L16); cadeirio'r bardd = to chair the bard at the Eisteddfod; sentence from p. 162

karty.priklad: Gobeithio na fydda i'n chwydu.
karty.priklad_cs: I hope I won't be sick.
karty.mnemo: CHWYD! – the sound you make when you're sick.

extra.pozn: sentence from the text about the sea voyage (mordaith), p. 164

karty.priklad: Ameer sy'n lapio'r anrhegion.
karty.priklad_cs: Ameer is wrapping the presents (emphatic sentence with sy).
karty.mnemo: Wrap it on your LAP (LAP-io): the present sits on your knees while you wrap it.

extra.pozn: sentence from the exercise Trefnu parti, p. 163

karty.cs: to treat; to handle, to deal with
karty.priklad: Cafodd hi ei thrin yn yr ysbyty.
karty.priklad_cs: She was treated in hospital (trin → [th]rin after ei = her, aspirate mutation).
karty.mnemo: trin = to treat, as in triniaeth (treatment) and siop trin gwallt.

extra.pozn: triniaeth = treatment (L12); siop trin gwallt = hairdresser's (L6); own example

karty.priklad: Mae'r erthygl yn tynnu sylw at broblemau'r ardal.
karty.priklad_cs: The article draws attention to the area's problems (problemau → [b]roblemau after at).
karty.mnemo: tynnu (to pull) + sylw (attention) = to pull attention towards something.

extra.pozn: pattern tynnu sylw at (at causes soft mutation); with a possessive: tynnu eich sylw at = to draw your attention to; sylw (L1); own example

karty.priklad: Mae hi wedi ymgeisio am bost yn y brifysgol.
karty.priklad_cs: She's applied for a post at the university (post → [b]ost after am; prifysgol → [b]rifysgol after y, feminine).
karty.mnemo: cais = application: ymgeisio = to apply.

extra.pozn: pattern ymgeisio am (am causes soft mutation); cais = application, ffurflen gais = application form (L3); ymgeisydd = applicant, candidate; own example
